module: Performance telemetry tracker: reports players' framerate from what the engine already measures for the overlay cycled by Ctrl+F ($fps::avg, min, p99, cpuTime, gpuTime). One "performance" event per reading, with no averaging or judgment: the server decides which framerate is too low. The interval (sampleIntervalSeconds, 300 s by default, clamped between 5 and 3600) comes from the server config.
notes: Readings are taken everywhere, menus included; each one says where it comes from: level is nil in menus and paused is set when the simulation is stopped.
The reading is ignored if $fps::avg is missing or <= 0.
The event contains fpsAvg, fpsMin, fpsP99, cpuMs, gpuMs and limitedBy (limiting factor according to performanceMetrics).

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: a single clock call and one comparison; takes a reading when the interval has elapsed.

dtSim.desc: Simulated delta time (s); <= 0 marks the reading as paused.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: reads sampleIntervalSeconds from the "performance" module config and switches to manual unload.
